## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] I ran the relevant frontend and/or Rust validation.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, user data, model weights, runtime downloads, databases, caches, or logs.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and failure states are documented where needed.
- [ ] Persisted-data compatibility was considered when applicable.
- [ ] Security and path-handling implications were considered when applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are included for meaningful UI changes when useful.
